answer: In our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, we employ a verifiable delay attestation mechanism to ensure Sybil resistance among autonomous agents. This mechanism leverages a stake-slashing matrix to penalize malicious agents, effectively rendering the tundra of Sybil attacks uninhabitable. By introducing a ripple effect of delayed attestations, honest agents can detect and respond to Sybil attempts, causing the attacker to wander into a trap of increasing economic costs, ultimately leading to a prohibitive capital lockup.
